1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the page
3: 
4: (function () {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   // Set canvas size (fallback if not set in HTML)
10:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 400;
11:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
12: 
13:   // Ship configuration
14:   const ship = {
15:     width: 40,
16:     height: 20,
17:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
18:     y: canvas.height - 30,
19:     speed: 5,
20:     color: '#0ff',
21:   };
22: 
23:   // Input handling
24:   const keys = {};
25:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
26:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
27: 
28:   // Asteroid pool
29:   const asteroids = [];
30:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
31:   let lastAsteroidTime = 0;
32: 
33:   // Bullet pool (optional shooting)
34:   const bullets = [];
35:   const bulletSpeed = 7;
36: 
37:   function spawnAsteroid() {
38:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 10;
39:     asteroids.push({
40:       x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
41:       y: -size,
42:       size,
43:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
44:     });
45:   }
46: 
47:   function update(dt) {
48:     // Move ship
49:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
50:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x += ship.speed;
51:     // Keep within bounds
52:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width, ship.x));
53: 
54:     // Shoot with space
55:     if (keys[' '] && bullets.length < 5) {
56:       bullets.push({ x: ship.x + ship.width / 2, y: ship.y });
57:     }
58: 
59:     // Update bullets
60:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
61:       const b = bullets[i];
62:       b.y -= bulletSpeed;
63:       if (b.y < 0) bullets.splice(i, 1);
64:     }
65: 
66:     // Spawn asteroids
67:     if (Date.now() - lastAsteroidTime > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
68:       spawnAsteroid();
69:       lastAsteroidTime = Date.now();
70:     }
71: 
72:     // Update asteroids
73:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
74:       const a = asteroids[i];
75:       a.y += a.speed;
76:       // Remove if off screen
77:       if (a.y > canvas.height) {
78:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
79:         continue;
80:       }
81:       // Collision with ship (lose condition)
82:       if (
83:         a.x < ship.x + ship.width &&
84:         a.x + a.size > ship.x &&
85:         a.y < ship.y + ship.height &&
86:         a.y + a.size > ship.y
87:       ) {
88:         // Game over: stop loop
89:         cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
90:         ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
91:         ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
92:         ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 80, canvas.height / 2);
93:         return;
94:       }
95:       // Collision with bullets (destroy asteroid)
96:       for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
97:         const b = bullets[j];
98:         if (
99:           b.x > a.x &&
100:           b.x < a.x + a.size &&
101:           b.y > a.y &&
102:           b.y < a.y + a.size
103:         ) {
104:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
105:           bullets.splice(j, 1);
106:           break;
107:         }
108:       }
109:     }
110:   }
111: 
112:   function draw() {
113:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
114:     // Draw ship
115:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
116:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.width, ship.height);
117:     // Draw asteroids
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
119:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
120:       ctx.beginPath();
121:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
122:       ctx.fill();
123:     });
124:     // Draw bullets
125:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
126:     bullets.forEach(b => ctx.fillRect(b.x - 2, b.y - 5, 4, 10));
127:   }
128: 
129:   let lastTime = 0;
130:   let animId;
131:   function loop(timestamp) {
132:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
133:     lastTime = timestamp;
134:     update(dt);
135:     draw();
136:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
137:   }
138:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
139: })();
